items.title_en: Renmin University Law School Dean visits MCI to explore academic partnership
items.summary_en: Representatives from Renmin University of China Law School visited the Manchester China Institute on 9 October 2026 to discuss potential academic collaboration. items.action_advice: 顾问建议：提醒关注中英法学学术合作的学生和家长，此类院校互访可能带来未来联合培养或访学机会，但目前尚无招生政策变化，应继续以官方招生信息为准，勿轻信非正式合作传闻。
